notes.title: Power Energy Shield
notes.content:
[p]Hello. I am a developer of the video game AI Peace Protocol. Today I will talk about the vision of the game mechanics of the power energy shield. 

The Power Energy Shield will completely neutralize all damage to the glider, however, using the power shield consumes a lot of energy. The Energy Shield in game will be implemented as a temporary invulnerability skill. The duration depends on the battery capacity. The recharge time depends on the power of the reactor. 

The battery and reactor will be separate components of the glider, which can be modularly replaced. 

While Power Energy Shield is activated its use the total energy of the glider's power systems.

So, the Power Energy Shield is a universal temporary protection from many dangers that await you in this peaceful but dangerous environment of game AI Peace Protocol. 

Wishlist game on Steam: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155100/"][/dynamiclink] [/p]
